title: Chapter 1383 - 6: Belonging

Chapter 1383 - 6: Belonging

Chapter 1383: Chapter 6: Belonging

Between the expansive dimensional gaps, a grand celestial river flows mightily.

It sweeps across the universe, layer upon layer of space-time.

This is the celestial river dimension, a top-tier dimensional space on par with the Chaos Void dimension. Observing from afar, it is vast beyond imagination.

And at this moment, without knowing when, right by the side of this celestial river, sits a colossal figure cross-legged.

This colossal figure is nearly one-tenth the size of the entire celestial river. Even to the grand celestial river, so vast to time-based beings, it seems to flow shallow like a small stream under this figure’s feet.

The surface of the body is wrapped in layers of clouds, almost merging with the dimensional gaps, but at this moment, as the figure raises their right hand and looks down into their palm,

the obscure clouds gradually disperse, revealing this endlessly vast and colossal body.

"What is this?"

Upon the raised palm of the colossal figure, the Gray Ancestor, like a ’particle’, feels a chill in their heart, looking toward the terrifying pressure enveloping from all sides, showing a look of disbelief.

The face looking down from above the sky is from Lin Yuan, who he suppressed, but this does not surprise Gray Ancestor.

To have cultivated to the thirteenth level of time-based life, possessing multiple combat-ready physical forms is no unusual.

What truly shocks Gray Ancestor in his heart is the powerful physical form of Lin Yuan, astonishingly equal to one-tenth of the celestial river dimension?

Gray Ancestor can clearly feel that the physical form Lin Yuan is displaying is not some Fatian Xiangdi technique, but a real and authentic physical physique.

"So, now what will you use to resist me?"

Lin Yuan looks down upon the small ’particle’ Gray Ancestor in his palm, voice booming.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit was suppressed by Gray Ancestor using his own Origin Dao, but it’s not without use.

To suppress the Taiji Primordial Spirit, Gray Ancestor has to divert a substantial amount of focus and effort, even unable to freely mobilize his own Origin Dao.

If slightly careless, the Taiji Primordial Spirit could ’break out’.

"A powerful physical form doesn’t necessarily mean strong prowess."

Gray Ancestor collects his thoughts, indeed shaken by Lin Yuan’s terrifying physical form, but strength is not determined by physical form alone.

Gray Ancestor’s physical body may not match Lin Yuan’s, but so what? As a Second Realm time-based lifeform, he has ways to counteract such a formidable existence.

"Then let’s try." Lin Yuan doesn’t waste words, still looking down upon the ’particle’ Gray Ancestor in his palm.

...

"Is that also a Second Realm time-based life from beyond the Chaos Void?"

Inside the celestial river dimension, many time-based lifeforms also notice this scene, watching the towering and enormous figure from afar, just feeling dry-mouthed and tongue-tied. The body of a time-based lifeform can adjust its size, and if forcibly enlarged, not to mention achieving the proportion of one-tenth of the celestial river dimension.

One could even match a complete celestial river dimension, they can achieve it.

But it’s meaningless.

Just because you grow larger doesn’t mean your strength will increase.

A body too large would only disperse its own combat power.

Allowing the enemy to break through with a single strike.

However, the enormous body at present doesn’t have any weak points, it’s utterly a real physical physique.

"With such a powerful physical form, even relying solely on physical prowess, it’s enough to suppress us all."

The hearts of the observing time-based lifeforms tremble. Simply put, as long as Lin Yuan displays such a physical physique, even standing there for them to attack, they wouldn’t be able to break through the defense.

While Lin Yuan’s casual attack, as long as it grazes them, for them, the First Realm time-based lifeforms, it’s a severe blow.

"Galaxy..."

Lord Mo Xu and other time-based beings are also closely observing, watching this colossal figure displayed in front of many time-based lifeforms at present, their thoughts equally hard to calm.

Lin Yuan’s power is too strong, and his growth speed is too fast, far faster than the initial timelines observed by them.

"But the Galaxy is ultimately not a Second Realm, hasn’t realized his own Origin Dao..."

Lord Mo Xu inevitably still has some concerns, as other time-based lifeforms instinctively consider Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor both as Second Realm time-based lifeforms.

The current conflict between the two is also a fight between Second Realm time-based lifeforms.

But in fact, Lin Yuan has just entered the First Realm. Even though relying on his own foundation to contend with the Second Realm, but over time, would any problems arise, nobody knows.

However, even though Lord Mo Xu worries internally, he also understands that the upcoming battle won’t be something he can intervene in.

And not just intervening, even to watch related future timelines, to know the outcome of the struggle in advance, is impossible, as for Lin Yuan, his own timelines are hazy, and the same goes for Gray Ancestor.

The future timelines of these two entities, these First Realm time-based lifeforms cannot see specific details.

...

Besides the time-based lifeforms in the celestial river dimension watching.

From further within the gap regions, probing glances are cast likewise.

Two Second Realm time-based life forms battling, placed in this gap region, is exceedingly rare, not a single time-based life form would miss out, even those among the Second Realm time-based life forms are observing from afar.

"I’ve heard about this Gray Ancestor, from far gap regions, but the Second Realm invited by Chaos Void..."

The Mother of the Screw Realm has a puzzled look, she is also a Second Realm time-based life form, knowledgeable and informed about many powerful entities of the same level, but regarding Lin Yuan?

He is exceptionally unfamiliar.

Lin Yuan has displayed means of a physical body comparable to one-tenth of the celestial river dimension, indicating this time-based life form surely specializes in physical form at the Second Realm.

But such powerful entities, there are only a few, with obvious traits, which Lin Yuan does not match.
